supported_architecture: Conventional diaphragm cover reacts spring load through fulcrum supports; tangential straps locate, retract and drive the pressure plate.
Disc torque flows through carrier/retainer, spring windows and hub flange to the splined hub; friction elements damp relative motion.
application_limits: These are generic training examples, not identified Ford07-098 drawings.
The illustrated standard cover has three strap lugs; that count is not verified for this truck.
Several distinct damper arrangements appear. None establishes this truck's spring count, preload, travel, friction stack or diaphragm-finger count.
Do not import self-adjusting-clutch parts into the1994 baseline.

implementation.effect: Explicitly tracks unresolved physical connections and prevents ordinary installation of the incomplete boundary study.
implementation.geometry_disposition: No generic spring/finger counts or rigid surrogate torque connections added. Existing comparison geometry remains isolated until applicable interfaces can be reconstructed.
